jobs.description:
Founded in 1894, Universal Genève is an iconic Swiss watchmaking Maison celebrated for its rich heritage and timeless elegance. Known as the “Couturier de la Montre”, the Maison unites technical excellence with refined design, crafting timepieces with the same precision, creativity, and attention to detail as a couture creation. Today, Universal Genève enters a new chapter. Its revival is shaped by exceptional timepieces and a commitment to offering a client journey that is seamless, personal, and elevated. At Universal Genève, every experience is crafted with intention. Every gesture, every interaction, every detail is tailored to the individual rather than the catalogue. This philosophy shapes the head of retail excellence and conciergerie role, where service is approached with the same care and precision as watchmaking itself.

The Expert We Seek: You are a structured, self-starter and entrepreneur, detail-driven operations leader with a deep understanding of luxury retail and a genuine feel for high-end client service. You oversee both the operational excellence of the Geneva flagship and the Maison's conciergerie function on a global scale, including direct responsibility for the concierge team. You sit between HQ and the boutique floor, setting the standards, KPIs, and processes that allow every market to perform at the level the Maison demands, while ensuring every client-facing moment is stitched together without a seam showing. Your Craft: Retail Operations & Standards
• You will build and own the operational framework of the Geneva flagship and roll it out internationally, defining processes, service rituals, and standards that will scale with the Maison's retail operations globally.
• You will run seamless daily boutique operations while building processes designed to be deployed consistently as the network grows internationally.
• You will ensure compliance with international tax regulations, customs requirements, and relevant trade legislation, safeguarding seamless cross-border transactions and client satisfaction.
• You will coordinate the export and delivery of bespoke and couture creations, overseeing all logistics, customs documentation, and regulatory requirements to ensure a flawless client experience.
• You will maintain a strong understanding of evolving import/export regulations, VAT considerations, and luxury goods legislation across key markets.
• You will liaise with logistics partners, customs brokers, and internal stakeholders to manage the secure and timely shipment of high-value bespoke and couture pieces worldwide.
• You will monitor operational performance, identify friction points, and implement concrete improvements that directly support the Maison’s commercial results.
• You will define, track, and steer the KPIs for both the retail and concierge teams, owning performance targets as much as their delivery.
• You will oversee stock and merchandising management, ensuring inventory levels, product presentation, and replenishments consistently reflect the Maison standards across all locations. Conciergerie & VIC Experience
• You will lead the Maison’s concierge function globally, managing the concierge team and setting the standards of VIC and VVIC service excellence across all markets.
• You will build and maintain a network across the world's finest hotels, restaurants, and cultural institutions to ensure our clients receive exceptional treatment in every city they encounter the Maison.
• You will work closely with the sales team to prepare every important client visit in detail, ensuring the environment, product selection, and hospitality are all perfectly in place before the client arrives.
• You will ensure that every interaction with a VIC or VVIC client reflects the Maison’s standards of discretion, warmth, and absolute attention to detail. After-Sales & Client Delivery
• You will define the Maison’s global after-sales standards, acting as the point of accountability between the boutique, the repair center, and the client.
• You will manage the secure global delivery of remote purchases, coordinating logistics, customs, insurance, and client communication end-to-end. Team Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration
• You will act as the operational link between the UG HQ and all retail locations globally, translating strategic direction into clear, executable processes that work consistently across markets.
• You will drive performance across the retail and concierge teams, setting clear expectations and conducting regular reviews to maintain the Maison's standards.
• You will support the Boutique Director in building the boutique’s internal culture of excellence, coaching the team on service standards and best practices. What Will Make You Successful:
• You bring 6 to 8 years of experience in luxury retail operations at a senior level, with experience working across international markets and a real understanding of what running a high-end boutique demands day to day.
• You are process-driven and highly organized, with a hands-on mindset to build operational frameworks from scratch.
• You have proven experience in developing and implementing retail strategies and best operational practices across multiple locations.
• You are comfortable owning performance data, setting KPIs, and using metrics to drive tangible improvements across retail and hospitality teams.
• You bring a real knowledge of the Geneva market and ideally an established network across the international luxury ecosystem.
• You are completely fluent in French and English. Additional languages are a distinct advantage.
• You carry the elegance, discretion, and quiet authority that the Maison demands, and people feel it from the moment they work with you. Tailor a New Legacy Every magnificent revival requires a visionary to guide it. If you are ready to measure, cut, and stitch the future of our retail excellence, we invite you to shape the vision of our Geneva flagship. Join Universal Genève, and craft an unforgettable experience for the world’s most discerning collectors.

Your new employer: We encourage everyone to bring true authenticity to work and contribute to our shared mission to redefine luxury. We prioritize the well-being of our employees by fostering an environment of diversity, equity, and inclusion, where every voice is heard and valued. We believe that happy, healthy employees are the key to success, which is why we offer competitive benefits, including:
• Home office (depending on position requirements)
• Referral program
• Development opportunities
• Culture of feedback Want to take on this mission and join our team? Apply now!

Founded in 1894, Universal Genève is an iconic Swiss watchmaking Maison celebrated for its rich heritage and timeless elegance. Known as the “Couturier de la Montre”, the Maison unites technical excellence with refined design, crafting timepieces with the same precision, creativity, and attention to detail as a couture creation. Today, Universal Genève enters a new chapter. Its revival is shaped by exceptional timepieces and a commitment to offering a client journey that is seamless, personal, and elevated. At Universal Genève, every experience is crafted with intention. Every gesture, every interaction, every detail is tailored to the individual rather than the catalogue. This philosophy shapes the Conciergerie Ambassador role, where service is approached with the same care and precision as watchmaking itself.

For those ready to build a legacy Joining Universal Genève at this stage means becoming part of a rare and defining relaunch, with the opportunity to help shape a new standard of client experience. As a Conciergerie Ambassador (f/m/x), you are the first voice and first impression of the Maison. You will ensure that every interaction—whether a simple inquiry or a complex request—is handled with precision, care, and intention. For those who value craft, ownership, and excellence in execution, this role offers the chance to contribute to a truly distinctive and modern vision of luxury service. Role overview The Conciergerie Ambassador (f/m/x) is an elevated client interface, operating across phone and email as the primary entry point to the Maison. This is a coordination-driven, content-led role, ensuring that each client request is handled end-to-end with clarity and consistency. Every interaction is approached as part of a single, continuous thread—from first contact to resolution, without fragmentation or loss of quality. The role requires a strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and service intuition—knowing when to act, how to anticipate, and how to adapt to each client context. Your craft Client interface & Maison representation
• Act as the first point of contact for all client inquiries via phone and email
• Represent the Maison with precision, clarity, and consistency in every interaction
• Provide accurate and structured information on products, services, and processes
• Ensure each touchpoint reflects a tailored and considered approach, never generic Inquiry management & coordination
• Handle a broad range of client topics, including product information, availability, orders, and after-sales
• Act as a central coordination point, connecting clients with boutiques, HQ, and relevant departments
• Ensure each request is followed through end-to-end, maintaining continuity and accountability
• Approach every interaction as part of a seamless journey, avoiding fragmentation or handoffs Orders, delivery & remote purchase facilitation
• Support clients in navigating pre-orders, orders, and delivery processes
• Coordinate home deliveries and boutique collections, ensuring clarity and personalization
• Provide guidance on shipping timelines, taxes, and logistics
• Facilitate remote purchases when initiated by the client, ensuring a smooth and reassuring experience
• Act as a relay with boutiques and logistics teams to ensure execution aligns with client expectations Client data & system discipline
• Capture and maintain accurate client data, including preferences and contextual information
• Record meaningful qualitative insights (interests, previous interactions, expectations)
• Ensure data is structured, complete, and actionable across systems
• Contribute to a consistent and reliable client knowledge base Escalations & cross-functional collaboration
• Manage client escalations with ownership and composure
• Liaise with after-sales, logistics, and boutique teams to resolve issues
• Use available systems to access and communicate relevant information
• Take responsibility for resolving issues proactively, ensuring the client experience remains intact What will make you successful
• At least 3 years of experience in luxury client services, premium contact centers, hospitality, or coordination roles
• Fluent (native level) in English and at least 1 of the following languages: French, German or Arabic
• Strong communication skills with a clear, structured, and composed delivery

• You will drive the acquisition of new ultra-high-net-worth clients by leveraging your network and executing highly targeted outreach strategies.

• You will design a seamlessly tailored experience by anticipating the unique desires of each client.
• You will execute the selling ceremony the UG way, threading the Maison's heritage and craftsmanship into every step of the client journey to naturally guide each collector toward their acquisition.
• Your hospitality approach must adapt to each individual so that every gesture feels measured and entirely bespoke.
• You will proactively resolve any service friction and turn potential challenges into an opportunity.
• You will cultivate long-term loyalty by creating unique moments and personalized follow-ups that resonate directly with the clients. Brand Ambassadorship
• You will represent our core values and act as a dedicated ambassador for the Maison both inside the boutique and at external networking events.
• You will share your passion for our watches and the brand's history with local and international clients.
• You will master our collections and brand history, while staying up to date with industry news and the competitive landscape.
• You will actively support and participate in boutique events, private viewings, and client entertainment to generate new sales opportunities. CRM & Operational Precision
• You will leverage your CRM data to proactively generate new sales opportunities, identify up-selling moments, and maximize the commercial value of every client relationship.
• You will capture meaningful details from your interactions to build an authentic, long-term understanding of each client's journey with the Maison.
• You will partner closely with the Head of Retail Excellence & Conciergerie to coordinate secure global deliveries for remote purchases.
• You will analyze your personal sales metrics proactively to refine your recruitment strategies and consistently exceed ambitious commercial targets. What Will Make You Successful

• You demonstrate a strong aptitude for active client recruitment, with the entrepreneurial drive and capability to build a high-net-worth client portfolio from scratch.
• You are results-oriented, with the tenacity and elegance to close high-ticket sales entirely through distance selling.
• You are a dynamic, passionate, and self-driven Salesperson who wants to become an ambassador for our prestigious Maison.
• You are a collaborative team player who balances personal sales targets with the overall success of the boutique.
• You are solution-oriented, using all available tools to resolve issues with diplomacy.
• You are completely fluent in French and English. Additional languages are a plus.

The Leader We Seek As the Grand Vendeur (f/m/x) of our Geneva flagship, you are the most senior sales presence on the floor, operating a step ahead in profile, leadership, and commercial impact. You will carry the Maison’s most critical client relationships, going far from the boutique to recruit ultra-high-net-worth collectors and hosting exclusive couture reveals. You are a master storyteller who translates the brand's heritage into high-value sales while mentoring the broader boutique team. Candidates must bring an established portfolio of high-value clients and a proven network within the luxury sector. A willingness to travel for exclusive events, client engagements, and industry gatherings is essential to cultivating and strengthening key relationships. Your Craft: UHNW Client Acquisition & Network Development
• You will drive the acquisition of new ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) collectors by actively leveraging your local network and partnering with external business introducers.
• You will also work off-site and proactively engage high-potential prospects in their own environment (homes, offices, private clubs).
• You will act as a key ambassador at regional roadshows, private trunk shows, and international Maison events to capture fresh profiles for the brand.
• You will analyze your portfolio regularly, identifying opportunities to deepen relationships with existing VVICs and strategically reactivate inactive clients. High-Value Sales & The Couture Ceremony
• You will focus intentionally on generating high-value turnover, specifically driving the sales of our most exclusive, rare, and capsule timepieces to your VIC/VVIC portfolio.
• You will lead the selling ceremony end-to-end, hosting bespoke private appointments and couture reveals, delivering an unforgettable client experience.
• You will build deep, lifelong loyalty through highly personalized outreach and exceptional treatment, keeping client discretion and privacy at the forefront.
• You will manage client expectations with discretion and precision, ensuring each interaction reinforces the Maison’s exclusivity and heritage. Boutique Presence & Operations
• You will maintain the highest standard of professionalism and appearance on the boutique floor and set the tone for how the Maison conducts business.
• You will collaborate with the Boutique Manager to mentor and share your expertise with the Client Advisor team on elevating the floor's overall approach to VIC service and closing techniques.
• You will collaborate with the Boutique Manager on visual merchandising, display maintenance, and the organization of boutique materials and accessories.
• You will respect and actively promote all security and cash-handling protocols to protect the Maison's assets. What will make you successful:
• You bring 6+ years of documented success in high-end sales, with a proven track record of managing and closing significant VIC and VVIC portfolios.
• You have built or managed a substantial personal client book of ultra-high-net-worth individuals and demonstrated consistent ability to close complex, high-value transactions.
• You possess a genuine, working knowledge of the luxury watch market, who the competitors are, what collectors value, and where the market is moving.
• You are a skilled closer. You can read a client and bring high-ticket sales to completion without pressure or compromise.
• You work independently and hold yourself accountable. You don't need supervision to execute. You set your own targets and hit them.
• You understand that discretion is non-negotiable. Client relationships and Maison business remain completely confidential.

jobs.description:
We are a dedicated Squad on a mission to redefine Swiss watchmaking, rooted in our legacy since 1884. Driven by innovation and precision we create timepieces that combine modern-retro design with casual, approachable, and sustainable luxury — powered by passionate teams around the world. Join our vibrant team in Zurich as a Content Specialist (f/m/x) and be part of something extraordinary! As a Content Specialist (f/m/x) , you will support the delivery of engaging and high-performing digital experiences across our global websites. You will manage website content, coordinate product launches and campaigns, and work closely with Marketing, E-commerce, Creative, and Tech teams to bring initiatives to life. This role is ideal for someone who combines technical website expertise with a business mindset, is comfortable with digital tools, and enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Your contribution:
• You will manage and publish website content using our CMS, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and a premium brand experience.
• You will support global product launches, promotional campaigns, and seasonal initiatives across multiple markets.

• You will perform basic asset retouching and adaptations, including image cropping, resizing, background edits, and content preparation for web use.
• You will coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective digital solutions.
• You will proactively identify website content issues, bugs, and opportunities for improvement, translate findings into clear business and functional requirements, and create well-defined tickets to support efficient prioritization and implementation by Tech team.
• You will contribute to site navigation, merchandising, and content optimization activities.
• You will manage tasks and workflows through Jira and other project management tools.
• You will leverage AI-powered tools to streamline workflows and improve day-to-day efficiency. Do you think there is even more to discover in this role? You're right — apply today and learn more! You will fit well to our squad if you have:
• 2–3 years of experience in content management, e-commerce, digital marketing, or a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with CMS platforms (Contentful experience is a plus).
• Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, with the ability to independently retouch and adapt digital assets for web publication.
• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools in a cross-functional environment.
• A good balance of technical aptitude and commercial awareness.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and solution oriented mindset.
• Hands-on experience working with PIM and DAM platforms and their role in supporting efficient content operations and omnichannel consistency.
• Familiarity with HTML/CSS and an understanding of web technologies are a plus.

• Curiosity and enthusiasm for using AI tools to enhance productivity and optimize workflows. We invite you to apply even if you do not meet all of these criteria.

jobs.title: Spécialiste Payroll (50 %) m/f/x
jobs.description:
Nous sommes un Squad engagé dont la mission est de redéfinir la chronométrie, ancrée dans notre héritage depuis 1884. Portés par l’innovation et la précision, nous créons des montres qui allient un design néo-rétro à un luxe décontracté, accessible et durable — imaginées et conçues par des équipes passionnées à travers le monde. Afin de renforcer notre équipe RH, nous recherchons un(e) Spécialiste Payroll à 50 % pour assurer le bon déroulement des activités de paie de nos entités suisses. Ce poste offre une flexibilité dans l'organisation du temps de travail, permettant d'adapter la présence en fonction des périodes de forte activité liées au cycle de paie et aux clôtures annuelles .

Vos responsabilités:
• Assurer la préparation, le traitement et le suivi de la paie mensuelle en collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes et les prestataires externes.
• Garantir l'exactitude des calculs de paie, des paiements et des activités administratives associées.
• Gérer les obligations légales liées à la paie (assurances sociales, impôt à la source, allocations familiales, caisse de pension et autres cotisations obligatoires).
• Coordonner les données de paie, contrôler les résultats et participer aux réconciliations de paie.
• Assurer la qualité et la mise à jour des données liées à la paie dans les systèmes RH et de paie.
• Gérer les aspects de paie liés au cycle de vie des collaborateurs (entrées, modifications, départs, absences, missions internationales, avantages, etc.).
• Participer aux déclarations légales, aux audits, aux clôtures annuelles ainsi qu'au reporting lié à la paie.
• Répondre aux questions des collaborateurs, des managers et des partenaires externes concernant la paie.
• Assurer le remplacement et la continuité des opérations de paie en Suisse en cas d'absence.
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue, à la standardisation et à la documentation des processus et des contrôles de paie.
• Participer aux projets liés à la paie, aux systèmes RH et à l'optimisation des processus. Votre profil:
• Formation commerciale (CFC) ou formation équivalente ; une spécialisation en RH ou en paie constitue un atout.
• Minimum 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la paie, idéalement en Suisse.
• Bonne connaissance de la législation suisse en matière de paie, d'assurances sociales et de conformité.
• Expérience avec des systèmes RH et de paie (SuccessFactors, SAP ou équivalent).
• Excellente rigueur, sens de l'organisation et souci du détail.
• Personne fiable, discrète, autonome et orientée solutions.
• Esprit d'équipe, sens du service et bonnes capacités de communication. Langues:
• Français et anglais courant (minimum B2)
• L'allemand constitue un atout

Votre nouvel employeur : Chez Breitling, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve de véritable authenticité au travail et à contribuer à notre mission commune de redéfinir le luxe. Nous accordons la priorité au bien-être de nos collaborateurs en favorisant un environnement de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion, où chaque voix est entendue et valorisée. Nous croyons que des collaborateurs heureux et en bonne santé sont la clé du succès, c'est pourquoi nous offrons des avantages compétitifs, notamment :
• Télétravail (selon les exigences du poste)
• Montre au porter / montre à acheter
• Programme de recommandation/cooptation
• Opportunités de développement
• Congé maternité (17 à 19 semaines) Nos valeurs Chez Breitling, nous sommes... EPIC! :
• E ntrepreneuriat – Nous prenons des initiatives, faisons preuve d’agilité et osons remettre en question le statu quo.
• Performance – Nous visons l’excellence et livrons des résultats avec impact, précision et passion.
• I nnovation – Nous cultivons la créativité et repoussons sans cesse les limites pour façonner l’avenir.
• Considération – Nous prenons soin de nos collaborateurs, de nos clients et de notre planète, avec respect et responsabilité. Nous valorisons la diversité et nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement inclusif qui reflète l'excellence et le raffinement qui définissent notre marque. Nous accueillons les candidatures de tous horizons, sans distinction de race, de genre, d'âge, d'orientation sexuelle, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée. Nous invitons les candidats de tous horizons à soumettre leur candidature pour rejoindre notre équipe, où l'inclusion est au cœur de notre vision de l'élégance et du prestige. Veuillez noter que l'utilisation d'équipements de protection est requise pour certains postes afin de maintenir les plus hauts standards de sécurité et de précision lors des opérations dans nos ateliers.

jobs.description:
We are a dedicated Squad on a mission to redefine Swiss watchmaking, rooted in our legacy since 1884. Driven by innovation and precision we create timepieces that combine modern-retro design with casual, approachable, and sustainable luxury — powered by passionate teams around the world. Join our vibrant team in Zurich as a Managing Editor (f/m/x), and be part of something extraordinary! You will lead and orchestrate our Creative Storytelling process across campaigns, product launches, partnerships, and brand platforms. This is a hybrid role: part writer-editor, part project manager. You will shape the words and the workflow behind them, working closely with copywriters, designers, and stakeholders. You will combine editorial instinct with operational precision. You can refine a paragraph, define a tone of voice, structure a narrative arc, and build the timeline that ensures it goes out on time.

jobs.description:
We are a dedicated Squad on a mission to redefine Swiss watchmaking, rooted in our legacy since 1884. Your contribution:
• You will support the creation of social media content, adapting it for specific channels in collaboration with the editorial and brand communications teams
• You will assist with updating social media guidelines for internal and external partners
• You will help monitor user engagement and contribute to community management across all channels
• You will engage with our online communities by responding to comments and questions, fostering positive interactions
• You will assist with updating the Digital Asset Management platform
• You will support social media reporting and analytics
• You will stay up to date on new digital technologies and social media trends, contributing ideas to optimize reach and engagement Do you think there is even more to discover in this role? You're right — apply today and learn more! You will fit perfectly into our team if:
• You are currently pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media or a related field
• You have a first experience or strong personal interest in social media, whether through studies, personal projects or a previous internship
• You are familiar with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere or equivalent) — hands-on experience is a plus
• You have a curiosity for social media tools and analytics (Brandwatch, Hootsuite or equivalent)
• You are rigorous, detail-oriented and demonstrate a strong work ethic
• You are creative, proactive and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team
• You have excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. French or German is a valued asset We invite you to apply even if you do not meet all of these criteria.
